# Everything you can say to JARVIS

Generated 2026-10-30 from the skill patterns, config/commands.yaml, config/intents.yaml, tests/phrases.yaml and tools/variants.py.
Each of the 34534 phrases was run through tools/dryrun.py and reached a feature, not Claude. Grouped by skill, then by what it runs.

`<text>` is any words, `<n>` any number. `{slot}` is a value you fill in. Say "jarvis" anywhere in the sentence to wake it.
